2026_01_DAL_NYG.headline: Dallas’ protection adjustments collide with a Giants offense built around Jaxson Dart’s mobility
2026_01_DAL_NYG.paragraph1: Dallas enters the opener with Malik Davis out and an offensive line already working through a starting adjustment, while New York lists Malik Nabers as questionable. The Giants can lean on Jaxson Dart’s movement to create stress outside the original play design, but Dallas can answer by keeping rush lanes disciplined and forcing longer drives. On the other side, the Cowboys must keep protection organized enough to avoid giving New York short fields or obvious pressure opportunities.
2026_01_DAL_NYG.model_rationale: Dallas needs stable protection and disciplined rush lanes, because New York can create extra offense when Dart escapes structure and turns broken plays into useful gains.
